newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS downgrades Centocor.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS downgrades Centocor.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said analyst Tim Wilson downgraded Centocor Inc to buy from strong buy, saying sales of the blood-clot busting drug ReoPro "appear to be losing steam."
-- Said Centocor and partner Eli Lilly and Co lowered guidance on 1997 ReoPro sales to $230-to-$250 million from the $250-$270 million range.

-- In a report Wilson cut his 1997 estimate for the drug's sales to $245 million from $259 million. He cut his 1998 estimate to $354 million from $490 million and dropped 1999 to $458 million from $649 million.
